premise: Abhi, a wealthy young man, conceals his affluent background and adopts the identity of 'Vijay' to work in a coffee shop alongside Meera, whom he loves, while avoiding family-arranged marriages.

nicknames.name: Abhi
nicknames.note: Alias used by Abhi while working at the cafe and living with Meera

running_bits: Abhi making up absurd cover stories (like running stage shows under the name Abhiram or concocting fake tour package calls) to explain slips in his identity.
relationships: Abhi and Meera: Roommates and cafe co-workers; Abhi is secretly in love with Meera under his alias Vijay.
Abhi and Harshitha: Long-time family friends from Vizag whose parents wish to arrange their marriage.
Abhi and his father: Rich businessman father trying to guide Abhi into marriage and family business.
Krishna and Satya: Husband and wife navigating marital insecurities and financial independence.
Radha and Krishna: Relatives/cousins; Radha stays with them and confides in Krishna.
Krishna and Subbu: Childhood school friends; Subbu secures Krishna a job as a medical representative.
Raghu and Satya: Office colleagues; Raghu is secretly obsessed with the married Satya.
